newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- flat ahead of Port bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- flat ahead of Port bonds.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices were unchanged to slightly weaker in early trading, ahead of Lehman Brothers' $930 million Port Authority of New York and New Jersey pricing.
Lehman said it was in the process of pricing the deal, the largest of the week, and would release details of the pricing shortly.

Secondary action ahead of the pricing was muted, traders said, after ending Thursday's session 1/8 to 1/4 point lower. One trader said prices on some issues were off about one basis point, but activity is extremely quiet.
In the muni secondary, bids on Delaware River Port Authority FGIC 5-1/2s of 2026 were up two basis points, to 5.89 percent. Texas Turnpike Authority FGIC 5.0s of 2025 were unchanged at 5.90 percent.
In the government market, the benchmark 30-year bond was down 3/32 at 93-22/32 to yield 7.14 percent.
In debt futures, the June municipal contract lost 2/32 to 112-7/32, while June T-bonds were down 4/32 at 107-6/32. The MOB spread widened to 161 ticks from 159 at the close on Thursday.
